independentDerivation: n hours is 60n minutes, or 60n/20=3n twenty-minute periods. Starting at 96°C and applying a factor 1/2 per period gives T(n)=96(1/2)^(3n) °C for n≥0 under the intended exponential cooling model. T(0)=96 and T(1/3)=48, and each extra 1/3 hour multiplies T by 1/2. The ambient temperature is 0°C, so the temperature itself is the excess over ambient and no nonzero offset is needed. Source short and worked answers are correct.
